description: Estimate whether decoupling a jointly owned Singapore home is worth it before buying another property: compares BSD and legal costs of transferring a share against the ABSD saved on the new purchase (for a Singapore Citizen, second-property 20% becomes first-property 0%; for a PR, 30% becomes 5%). Also estimates the CPF refund and the break-even purchase price. From Propely (propely.sg), the owner-direct condo marketplace in Singapore. Indicative figures, not legal or financial advice.

cpfUsed.description: CPF Ordinary Account principal used for the current property in Singapore dollars (SGD)

marketValue.description: Market value of the current jointly owned property in Singapore dollars (SGD)

newPurchasePrice.description: Price of the new property being bought in Singapore dollars (SGD)

profile.description: sc = Singapore Citizen, pr = Permanent Resident

sharePercent.description: Percentage share being transferred to the other owner

yearsHeld.description: Years the CPF has been used (for accrued interest at 2.5% p.a.)

name: calculate_decoupling
title: Singapore property decoupling
